caption: An illustrative example of compositional in-context learning. Given simple-task demonstrations (words following * are capitalized; words in parentheses are swapped), the model solves each simple task but fails to compose them on the composite task, producing a wrong output.

The exact match accuracy (y-axis) vs the model scale (x-axis, "b" stands for billion) for Capitalization & Swap tasks. capital: performance on the simple capitalization task; swap: on the simple swap task; composite: in-context examples from simple tasks while test input is the composite task; composite_compose_incontext: in-context examples and test input are all from the composite task.

The word error rate (WER) vs the model scale on composite linguistic translation tasks. Dashed lines: simple tasks. Solid lines: composite tasks. Rows: (T1) Phrase Recombination with Longer Chain; (T2) Passive to Active and Object to Subject Transformation. Columns: different models. Lines: performance in different evaluation settings.
